description: Book Scanner — Collect page photos into a PDF, with a choice of Magic or Color enhancement. Try one spread first: uploaded spreads and camera captures are handled differently.. Runs in the browser. Covered by signup welcome credits and by the Day Pass (24-hour unlimited on this workspace group). All three credit-based workspaces unlock with the same one-time credit pack — there is no per-workspace subscription. See mioffice.ai/pricing for current plans.
